summary: Teaching wavefolder: one Dye Essence patch driven by 12 controls. A sine (with phase-locked FM from a second sine) pushed through one to six folding stages with a symmetry offset, then a low-pass gate that dims the brightness as the note fades and takes a strike at note-on, with an ADSR, unison and an output gain. Every control says what it does and what you will hear. Use it for metallic basses, bongo-like plucks, sizzling leads and West Coast timbres, or to learn how wavefolding makes harmonics.
use_for: A teaching wavefolder: metallic basses, bongo-like plucks and sizzling leads from one to six folding stages, a symmetry offset, timbre FM and a low-pass gate.

parameters.name: Wavefold
parameters.description: Amplifies the pure sine/triangle oscillator past the folding threshold so wave peaks invert back into the waveform multiple times.
parameters.how: Amplifies the pure sine/triangle oscillator past the folding threshold so wave peaks invert back into the waveform multiple times.
parameters.sound: Instead of clipping flat, the sound blooms with rich, metallic, and organic West Coast overtones.

parameters.name: Symmetry
parameters.description: Injects a DC bias offset prior to the wavefolder so positive and negative halves of the wave fold unequally.
parameters.how: Injects a DC bias offset prior to the wavefolder so positive and negative halves of the wave fold unequally.
parameters.sound: Shifts the harmonic balance between hollow odd harmonics (centered) and warm, nasal even harmonics (offset).

parameters.name: Fold Stages
parameters.description: Selects how many series folding circuits the signal passes through.
parameters.how: Selects how many series folding circuits the signal passes through.
parameters.sound: Lower stages sound warm and woody; 6 stages create dense, sizzling harmonic complexity on slight envelope sweeps.

parameters.name: Timbre FM
parameters.description: Applies phase-locked audio-rate frequency modulation to the core oscillator before it hits the wavefolder.
parameters.how: Applies phase-locked audio-rate frequency modulation to the core oscillator before it hits the wavefolder.
parameters.sound: Causes the folded peaks to churn and intermodulate, producing complex percussive and aggressive textures.

parameters.name: Low-Pass Gate
parameters.description: Morphs the output stage from a clean VCA (0%) to an optical low-pass gate (100%) that dims brightness as volume drops.
parameters.how: Morphs the output stage from a clean VCA (0%) to an optical low-pass gate (100%) that dims brightness as volume drops.
parameters.sound: Gives notes a natural, woody, acoustic bongo/marimba ring-out where high frequencies decay faster than bass.

parameters.name: Gate Strike
parameters.description: Hits the virtual optical gate with a sharp transient impulse at note-on.
parameters.how: Hits the virtual optical gate with a sharp transient impulse at note-on.
parameters.sound: Adds an organic, percussive "thwack" to the front of bass notes and West Coast plucks.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.sound: Low values create immediate, percussive plucks; high values produce slow, swelling pads.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.how: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.sound: Short decay makes notes snappy and tight; longer decay gives a gradual piano- or bell-like fade.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.how: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.sound: At 0% the synth behaves like a plucked or struck instrument; at 100% it holds full organ-like volume.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.sound: Short release stops notes abruptly; long release leaves an ambient tail that blends chords together.

parameters.name: Unison / Spread
parameters.description: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.how: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.sound: Thickens thin waveforms into wide, chorus-like stereo leads and pads.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.how: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.sound: Controls overall loudness; keep the clip light dark when the next machine expects levels at or below 0 dBFS.
